output.title: Where the time goes
output.description: Kafka carries 2,000 orders/s to Billing. A spike at 4 s turns a 0.3 s async path into seconds of waiting; hover for sampled p50, p95 and p99.

simulations.title: Where the time goes
simulations.description: A spike at 4 s builds a Billing backlog. Hover Billing or Receipts to see sampled latency and where time went.

action.text: At 4 s, the spike exceeds Billing capacity. Orders wait in Kafka; the work still takes 300 ms. Hover Billing to see where the time goes.
Billing’s p95 went from 0.3 s to 3.9 s; 78% of that is waiting in Kafka. Hover Billing for the split.

simulations.title: Room for steady orders
simulations.description: Two thousand orders per second fit. The same 300 ms work stays quick without a spike.

simulations.title: Slow Billing drill
simulations.description: At 3 s Billing slows 5×. Hover for latency measured since that fault; restoring it at 6 s starts a fresh window.

action.text: Billing is 5× slower. Hover Billing: its latency samples now count from this fault, not from restart.
Billing is restored. Hover Billing: the percentile window starts again at the restoration. Restart resets everything.
